# how (procedure-seeking)

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:typeHow`](gmeow-typeHow.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/typeHow>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/inquiry`](../../slices/inquiry.md)
- **Box roles:** [ABox role](../boxes/abox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A procedure-seeking question — its answerhood condition is a set of procedures / methods that achieve an end. Bridges the procedures extension: a [`typeHow`](gmeow-typeHow.md) question is answered by a procedure described there; the bridge is documented routing, not an axiom.

## Structure

**Types:** [`gmeow:QuestionType`](../classes/gmeow-QuestionType.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:typeHow`](gmeow-typeHow.md) as a controlled value typed as [`gmeow:QuestionType`](../classes/gmeow-QuestionType.md).
